payload.title: cart badge count updates after adding an item
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('cart-count-badge')
Expected: "3"
Received: "2"

retries.errorHead:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('cart-count-badge')
Expected: "3"
Received: "1"

note: A badge showing one less than expected reads like an off-by-one cart bug, but the two failed attempts land on two different wrong counts — 1 on the first attempt, 2 on the reported one — not the same wrong number repeating. A broken increment would fail on every add-to-cart with the same stale count once the code path is hit; landing on a different count each attempt matches the UI optimistically incrementing the badge locally then reconciling against the server's cart-total response, with the assertion catching a different point in that window each time — a UI-only race, not a broken increment.
